newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shohkoh Fund shares rise sharply.
newsitem.headline: Shohkoh Fund shares rise sharply.

text.p: Shohkoh Fund & Co Ltd advanced sharply on Monday, helped by expectations of firm demand for its shares even after the company offers new shares, traders said.
At 0452 GMT, the share price of Shohkoh Fund, the financing firm for small and medium-sized businesses, rose 2,100 yen to 32,700, after being bid-only. Turnover was 51,300 shares.
Shohkoh Fund said on Friday it would sell one million new shares to overseas investors at 30,000 yen per share. The payment date of the shares will be June 27.
Traders said shares of Shohkoh Fund were boosted by active purchases by foreign securities houses.
"Large-lot buying came from foreign brokerages and that fuelled speculative buying," said a trader at a medium-sized Japanese securities house.
